name: Dashanpusaurus
sum: Dashanpusaurus is a Middle Jurassic sauropod from Dashanpu, China, a non-neosauropod eusauropod in a 2013 analysis.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial skeleton; the paratype ZDM 5027 is another partial skeleton.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Peng et al. 2005
